snippet.title: STARSEEKER: Astroneer Expeditions | Gameplay Reveal
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now: https://www.starseekergame.com 🥕

Join our dev team on this exclusive first look at STARSEEKER gameplay and a sneak peek at some of the content coming in the ASTRONEER Megatech update.
 
STARSEEKER: Astroneer Expeditions is a game about discovery, cooperative expeditions, and camaraderie. Exploring deep space on the ESS Starseeker, you will need to work together with the entire crew of the space station to complete planet-wide objectives across a multitude of star systems wielding advanced future tech. Releasing in 2026.
 
Learn more: https://blog.astroneer.space/p/starseeker-direct-recap/
 
WISHLIST Now: 
- Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1454370/STARSEEKER_Astroneer_Expeditions/
- PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10014866 
- Xbox: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9NTZH69PZSH0


Visit our website for more info: https://www.devolverdigital.com/
